appearance:
Appearance

DateTimePickerStyle paints the field, the calendar surface, and every day state. TextCase and the Done settings finish the look.

Usage 

@uiForm.DateTimePicker(uiForm.DateTimePickerSettings{
	Label: "Stay",

	// OptionalFields
	CalendarButtonStyle: uiForm.InputActionButtonStylePlain,
	DoneButtonIconLeft:  "ph-calendar-check",
	DoneButtonLabel:     "Apply dates",
	DoneButtonStyle: uiForm.DateTimePickerDoneButtonStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "primary-500",
		IconSizeClass:   "text-sm",
		TextColor:       "primary-950",
	},
	IsRange:                 true,
	RangeEndLabel:           "Check-out",
	RangeEndTwoWayStatePath: "stayEnd",
	RangeStartLabel:         "Check-in",
	Style: uiForm.DateTimePickerStyle{
		CalendarBackgroundColor:    "neutral-950",
		CalendarBorderColor:        "primary-500/30",
		CalendarBorderRadius:       uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
		DayDisabledTextColor:       "neutral-700",
		DayHoverBackgroundColor:    "primary-500/10",
		DayMutedTextColor:          "neutral-500",
		DayRangeBackgroundColor:    "primary-500/25",
		DayRangeTextColor:          "primary-50",
		DaySelectedBackgroundColor: "primary-500",
		DaySelectedTextColor:       "neutral-950",
		DayTextColor:               "neutral-100",
		DayTodayRingColor:          "primary-400/50",
		FieldBackgroundColor:       "primary-950/40",
		FieldBorderColor:           "primary-500/30",
		FieldBorderRadius:          uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
		CalendarButtonIconColor:    "primary-300",
		RangeDividerColor:          "primary-500/30",
		RangeLabelTextColor:        "primary-300",
		TextColor:                  "primary-100",
	},
	TextCase:        uiToolset.TextCaseUpper,
	TwoWayStatePath: "stayStart",
})

date-time-and-timezone:
Date, Time, and Timezone

Mode datetime adds the centered time row. Setting Timezone adds the timezone select and writes the UTC offset into the value.

Usage 

@uiForm.DateTimePicker(uiForm.DateTimePickerSettings{
	Label: "Publish at",

	// OptionalFields
	Mode:                    uiForm.DateTimePickerModeDateTime,
	Timezone:                "America/Sao_Paulo",
	TimezoneTwoWayStatePath: "publishTimezone",
	TimezoneInputName:       "publishTimezone",
	TwoWayStatePath:         "publishAt",
})

hints:
Hints

HintDisplay picks a tooltip or a description below the field. HintIconStyle boxed turns the tooltip trigger into a box, and the HintDisplayTooltip colors and size classes customize the tooltip.

Usage 

@uiForm.DateTimePicker(uiForm.DateTimePickerSettings{
	Label: "Booking date",

	// OptionalFields
	HintDisplay:     uiForm.InputHintDisplayTooltip,
	HintIconStyle:   uiForm.InputHintIconStyleBoxed,
	HintValue:       "Bookings open at 9 in the morning.",
	TwoWayStatePath: "hintDate",
})

locale-and-bounds:
Locale and Bounds

Locale drives the format and the week start. MinValue and MaxValue disable the days outside the bounds.

Usage 

@uiForm.DateTimePicker(uiForm.DateTimePickerSettings{
	Label: "Appointment",

	// OptionalFields
	Locale:          "pt-BR",
	MinValue:        "2026-10-10",
	MaxValue:        "2026-11-20",
	TwoWayStatePath: "appointmentDate",
})

range:
Range

IsRange splits the field into captioned Start and End sides and paints the calendar span as one continuous band.

Usage

	Label: "Booking window",

	// OptionalFields
	IsRange:                 true,
	TwoWayStatePath:         "bookingStart",
	RangeEndTwoWayStatePath: "bookingEnd",
})

typed-input:
Typed Input

Type an ISO value and commit it with Enter or blur. Invalid text reverts to the stored value.

Usage 

@uiForm.DateTimePicker(uiForm.DateTimePickerSettings{
	Label: "Signed on",

	// OptionalFields
	InputName: "signedOn",
	Value:     "2026-10-16",
})
